snippet.title: PlayStation - Daisenryaku - Player's Spirit (1996) - [Intro]
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Daisenryaku: Player's Spirit is a Strategy game, developed by Dual and published by Oz Club, which was released in Japan in 1996.
